title: 24. How do I create WCAG compliant questionnaires with EUSurvey?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I create WCAG compliant questionnaires with EUSurvey.
short_answer: The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) consist of a set of guidelines for making content accessible, primarily for people with disabilities, but also for software such as mobile phones.
procedure: If you wish to make your survey WCAG compliant, please follow the instructions explained in this document (https://circabc.europa.eu/d/a/workspace/SpacesStore/78b03213-5cf4-4aab-8e90-ada7e2eb1101/WCAG_tutorial%20.pdf) .
